item.title: GSoC 2023 Rizin
item.description: Here’s My GSoC proposal and Acceptance Letter if you just want to take a look at that. Some Background I got my eyes on Rizin after a friend told me there’s a project that I might be interested in. I was working on my own x86 disassembler at that time and I wanted to convert that to an Intermediate Language that I wanted to create. This language would then be used to analyze binaries and decompile it.

item.title: My Programming Journey To GSoC
item.description: This is kind of a story like post and you won’t find anything technical here. Please skip this post if you find it not interesting :-) Why am I writing this? I just cleared GSoC 2023 and I want to just log everything I remember about my programming journey. Time Machine All Paths Lead To One! The One You Are Following At The Moment! So, from where shall I start? There are many events that lead to this path, and in fact I’d say all the events and paths I followed before lead here.
